checks.check: 1. KSRF rho: J, L, S_2(0.10), E_PNM(0.10) recomputed with independent code (own Fermi integrals checked against quadrature to 4e-16, own minimisation in y, S_2 from a numerical second derivative in delta); tau vs tau/2 convention

convention.KSRF: g = m_rho/(sqrt2 f_pi) = 5.952 is g_rho-pi-pi, the coupling to the isospin current; for the nucleon that is (g/2) tau, so S_rho = g^2 n/(8 m_rho^2) = 9.06 MeV at 0.16 fm^-3. Correct.
convention.width_check: Gamma(rho->pi pi) = g^2 p^3/(6 pi m^2) = 147.9 MeV with g = 5.952 vs 149.1 measured
convention.NL3_anchor: NL3's g_rho = 4.474 gives J = 37.36 only as a full-tau coupling (8.948 in tau/2) and 22.70 if misread as tau/2; published 37.4. The formula C n/8 with a tau/2 coupling is therefore validated.

J_window_28.5_34.9.note: 'No declared option reaches the J window' holds for the 1-sigma window; the best option is only 1.5 sigma low in J, so J alone does not exclude it at 2 sigma. It is excluded by L = 83.6 (> 65) and by A1 (S2(0.10) z = -8.7).

checks.check: 2. delta meson: sign and size against Liu-Greco-Baran-Colonna-Di Toro 2002 / Kubis-Kutschera 1997

evidence.formula: E_sym = kF^2/(6 EF*) + f_rho n/2 - (f_delta/2) (M*/EF*)^2 n / (1 + f_delta A(kF, M*)), A = 3 (n_s/M* - n/EF*) (checked by quadrature)
evidence.note: sign negative for any real coupling; -7.2 MeV per unit g_delta^2/4pi (7.19-7.24). In the textbook use the rho coupling is refitted upward to compensate; here the rho is fixed (KSRF), so the delta only lowers J.

checks.check: 3. density exponent of the missing isovector potential energy; robustness; comparison with standard models

evidence.what_is_wrong: the quoted range 0.26-0.29 is the spread between the two members only. The data uncertainty (dominated by J = 31.7 +- 3.2) is +-0.40, fourteen times larger. The implied coupling law is g^2 ~ n^(-0.72 +- 0.40), not 'n^-0.7'.

linear_contact_test.reading: a constant-coupling contact with a free strength (g_rho(tau/2) = 9.6-9.7, i.e. NL3-like: J = 37.5-37.8, L = 101-104) is disfavoured at 2.0-2.1 sigma by J and A1. It is excluded outright only by the session's L window 35-65 (local slope at n0 allowed 0.05-0.61 / 0.10-0.65); against L = 58.7 +- 28.1 the L of a linear contact at J = 31.7 (84-86) is +0.9..+1.0 sigma.

evidence.ordinary_or_unusual: ordinary. DD-ME2 0.05-0.08, DD2 0.11-0.14, TW99 0.14-0.16, FSUGold 0.28-0.29, NL3 (constant coupling) 1.00. NVG's requirement coincides with FSUGold and is within 0.5 sigma of the DD models. What is specific to NVG is the size: S_pot(n0) = 17.8-18.3 MeV against 12.9-15.1 in the standard sets, because m*/M = 0.84-0.87 leaves a small kinetic part (13.4-13.9 vs 17.5-19.2 MeV).
evidence.not_new_information: the earlier fitted contact (J = 32, L = 50) already had exponent 0.32-0.37; A1's S_2(0.10) = 25.3 was produced by that input. The inferred exponent restates the fitted contact.

checks.check: 4. E_PNM/N(0.10) = -3.75 MeV with no isovector term

evidence.reading: the kinetic energy is positive (+25.2 MeV free gas, +28.1 with M* = 0.893 M). The negative total comes from the isoscalar scalar-vector attraction (-31.9 MeV at 0.10 fm^-3, the same that gives E_SNM = -14.0), which acts on neutrons as on symmetric matter when no isovector repulsion exists. E_PNM - E_SNM = 10.3 MeV = S_2,kin (9.7) + quartic kinetic terms. The solution is the global minimum in y. Unphysical (bound neutron matter) but correct for the action alone.

checks.check: 5. does the verdict follow (not_this_field; rho tensor claim; 'must weaken strongly with density')

evidence.not_this_field: follows: no zero-parameter option closes R1 (J <= 26.7, 26.9 with g = 6.0; where J is closest L = 83.6 > 65) and A1 is lost in all of them (S2(0.10) 9.6-16.8, E_PNM -3.8..+3.3; z -8.7..-16). The delta has the wrong sign for any real coupling.
evidence.information_only: with a Bonn-strength rho (g(tau/2) = 7.05) and m_rho = qW, J = 31.9 / 30.2 reaches the window, but L = 95-104 and S2(0.10) = 19.6-20.1 still fail; the verdict does not depend on KSRF vs Bonn.
evidence.rho_tensor: not recomputed; consistent with symmetry (rho_0 ~ n_p - n_n = 0 in 16O) and with step4.log: 16O 1p 1.4497 -> 1.4497; 208Pb n1i/p1h ratio 1.27 -> 1.68 (y084, constant mass) against 1.05 measured. Sign as expected (neutron splitting up, proton down).
evidence.must_weaken_with_density: qualitatively supported (2.0-2.1 sigma from J and A1; firm with the declared L window), but 'strongly, as n^(0.26-0.29)' overstates the precision, and the requirement is a standard property of modern functionals, not a discriminating prediction.
evidence.A1_wording: 'A1 is lost' and 'R1 is open' are the same statement: A1's S_2(0.10) and E_PNM came from the fitted contact, not from the action.

overall_note: All numbers and the verdict not_this_field are confirmed by independent code. The key inference is refuted in its stated precision and novelty: the exponent is 0.26 +- 0.40 / 0.29 +- 0.40, and a sub-linear S_pot is ordinary.
corrected_statement: Числа подтверждены независимым кодом: ро-мезон KSRF (g_rho = 5.952 в конвенции tau/2, конвенция верна) даёт J = 22.93 / 22.49 МэВ при постоянной массе и 26.71 / 25.40 МэВ при m_rho = qW; окно J = 28.5-34.9 не достигается (лучший вариант ниже на 1.56 сигма, а его L = 83.6 МэВ выше окна 35-65). Дельта-мезон понижает J на 7.2 МэВ на единицу g_delta^2/4pi, знак и величина совпадают с формулой Лю и др. (2002). Без подогнанного контакта S_2(0.10) = 9.6-16.8 МэВ и E_PNM/N(0.10) = от -3.8 до +3.3 МэВ; значение -3.75 МэВ без изовекторного члена верно: это изоскалярное притяжение (-31.9 МэВ), а не ошибка в кинетической энергии. Вывод 'не это поле' следует. Исправление: недостающая изовекторная потенциальная энергия равна 17.8-18.3 МэВ при n0 и 15.8-15.9 МэВ при 0.10 фм^-3, но показатель степени равен 0.26 +- 0.40 (y*=0.84) и 0.29 +- 0.40 (y*=0.87), а не 0.26-0.29: указанный интервал есть разброс между двумя членами, а погрешность данных (в основном J = 31.7 +- 3.2) в 14 раз больше. Интервал 95%: от -0.7 до +1.0. Контакт с постоянной связью (n^1.0) отвергается на уровне 2.0-2.1 сигма по J и A1 и окончательно только объявленным окном L = 35-65 (такой контакт даёт J = 37.5-37.8, L = 101-104, как NL3). Требование ослабления с плотностью обычное, а не особенное: тот же показатель у DD-ME2 равен 0.05-0.08, у DD2 0.11-0.14, у TW99 0.14-0.16, у FSUGold 0.28-0.29 (у NL3 1.00). Особенность NVG в величине: 17.8-18.3 МэВ при n0 против 12.9-15.1 МэВ в стандартных наборах, потому что при m*/M = 0.84-0.87 кинетическая часть мала (13.4-13.9 МэВ). Этот показатель повторяет ранее подогнанный контакт (J = 32, L = 50, показатель 0.32-0.37) и новой информации не несёт.
